full_script: [cheerful] Diez frases con un hueco. Dilo antes de que se aclare. My mom makes me clean my room. Let me help you. You make me laugh. Ahora, nivel intermedio. They let us stay late. Don't make me say it again. I had my car fixed yesterday. She got her nails done. Y ahora, nivel experto. I'll have him call you back. Let me know what you think. The movie made me feel like crying.
